digest.component_or_area: completion verifier workflow and banking policy
propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero incremental criterion verdicts banked, violating the documented Incremental Banking contract and returning CompletionRecoveryError instead of evidence-backed PASS/FAIL

Pydantic AI executes a response's tool batch concurrently, so prompt-only instructions cannot enforce serialized evidence collection and record commits, causing late-batch deferral past budget exhaustion

A completion-only wrapper policy must atomically claim one governed repository action per response, count evidence responses per criterion, and invoke fallback met=false recording at the third evidence response if still unbanked to guarantee progress

The finite state machine (process manifest ids in order, use prefetched evidence first, select one repository action per response, commit through record_criterion_verdict, advance) must be expressed as system-level authority rather than untrusted ticket context to enforce banking transitions

The original 9895-aa2c-8907-4db6 run observed zero bank writes after 24 requests and 37 repository actions; the held-out dense oracle reproduced 0/3 bounded success with policy disabled and 2/3-or-better bounded success with policy enabled

Exact read-only replication of 9895-aa2c-8907-4db6 after the fix returned PASS with 8 source=tool bank entries, zero sidecar emits, and no status transition, proving the defect is resolved without caller regression
